translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Be Ngr Majzstret Kc Tqdrka'ngr X Olvz Kc Tqbzsz Ncblo Ngrde
Zbz Jiszs kc tqpipebzle badr nzycmne-ebzpxngr lc, mz nzalvztr-krde nidr kx nakrka'-zvzng, x bzkq nabzdr tzprlzm, nakrlzbzle mzli kx ayzlu-ngrbz Gct nzkrka'-krdr.
Rpibzle kx, “Kzdq kc majzstret mnc mz kzdq taon. Tramatqleu Gct x Lou scde, x trkxu mz drtqde nzale-angidr-krde nzwz-krde.
A' kzdq olvz kx bzsz ncblo ngrde mnc kz mz taon kc. Vz-zvzm bade tqrpibzle kx, ‘Ycmnepe-ngrbz ninge. Ycmneamu badr leplz kcng tzangqngutitrlr ninge mz drtc' nyznge, murde nakxmu-lxblrle naesz' bagr.’
Pxtxpx-zvz-ngrbz majzstret lc. A' kzdq mzli sc tqrpipele mz nide esz'-krde kx, ‘Kxmule-esz' tramatqwxu Gct x trkxu mz drtqnge leplz,
a' naycmnepe-ngrbo nide. Murde tramatxpewxu mz nzvz-zvz-krm olvz lc bange!’”
X rpi-mopwz Jiszs kx, “Naxlramu da kc tqpi majzstret lc tqdrka'ngr. Kape-ngrbzle da kc tqrlxtile, murde olvz kc nzrlxtx-zvz-krbzle da bade.
A' Gct trapuleu majzstret kxmule la. Murde nide tubq x mrlztile leplz nedeng. X trpnzngr nzaenzli-krde mzli kxboi mz nzokatr-krde kxmcpxleng, mz nzkrka'-zvz-krbzlr bade mz zbq kang kqlu.
Napibo bamu, Gct sa na-atubqti-anibzle da badr. A' mzli kc nayzlu-mou-ngrmc mz nrlc, mwx sa namcx leplz kxnzpipzng kxnzlxngiti-angidrbelr ninge.”
Nzycmne-ebzpxngr Kzdq Farzsi X Kxatakqti Takes
Jiszs pi-kzpzle nzycmne-ebzpxngr lc murde kzdung leplz nzabrtxtrpwzlr drtwrdr mz nzatubqti-lzbq-krdr, a' nzobqszo-ngrdr kzdung kz leplz.
Rpibzle kx, “Ncblo nzling nzvzdzng Mangr-nzangiongr mz nzkrka'ngr. Kzdq ngi Farzsi kx glqpx-lzbq. X kzdq kz kxatakqti takes, ncblo kx ale zvz alwx, x nzobqszo.

“Farzsi kc tutxpx kai esz'-krde, sc tqkrka'pe-ngrde nide esz'-krde. Rpipele kx, ‘Gct, awibo bam murde trapuwxu ncblo kxnzkqlung. Murde trprlvzu mzke' da, x trangqngutitrwxu, x trmwimiwxu olvz r ncblo kzble. X awi mz trnzapu-krngeu kxatakqti takes lcmonr, nqmq krde tqtrka.

Alex da kqlupxbz myaszpxle da kc tqpiq mz Lou scm. Murde mz wiki amrlx nzaxtx-krbo dakxnzng zbq li mz nzkrka'-krbo bam. X kabo bam kranzpnu ngr da kcng amrlx tqatatrpc', x kranzpnu ngr dalr nrlanc nyzngeng x animol nengeng.’”

Rpi-mopwz Jiszs kx, “A' kxatakqti takes kc tqtutrp rlru kxpipz x rblxtxpe nzobqlz-krde Heven mz nzkrka'-krde, murde drtqde myatxpe. X tztrle lomrde mz nzkrka'-krde, sc tqrpipele kx, ‘Gct, nayc mz drtwrm ninge, murde ninge ncblo ngr alwx! Ipqpxbz alwx ngrnge x atubqtim ninge. Eu, angida.’
X napibo bamu, mz nibrde, ncblo lc tubqbz mz nzobqkr Gct. A' ncblo kc kz, trtingr. Murde doa kx amyalz-lzbq mzli ka, sa na-avzo Gct nide yu. A' kx avzo-lzbq mzli ka, sa na-amyalz Gct nide.”
Doa Kx Nzlxngitilr Gct Mz Nzngini-krde King Rdr
Kzdung leplz nzvzmimlr doa kxnztopwzng x itoto nedrng mz Jiszs mz nzmaletr-krbzle nrkrdrtqdr x nzamrlz-krde nidr. A' kx nzmcpebzlr ncblo nedeng le, sc tzlclvztrpebzlr nzvz-krm leplz kcng.

A' Jiszs kqlebzle doa kxnztopwz kcng, sc tqrpipebzle mz ncblo nedeng kx, “Bzkq rpwa'-ngrbzmu badr doa lang tztopwzng nzvz-krmlr bange. Murde leplz kxnzmulr lcng nzlxngitilr Gct mz nzngini-krde King rdr.
Nadcpx da lc! Murde trpnzngr nzmnclz-krbzmu mz Gct mz nzngini-krde King rmu nzmu kx trapuwamuu doa lcng.”
Zbz kzdq kxrmailz r lr Jiu veabz mz Jiszs, rpibzle kx, “Kxakrlz, krlzx kx nim ncblo kxmrlz. ?Nike na-alex murde natwz-ngrne nzlungr kxboi?”
Rpibz Jiszs bade kx, “?Memule tqrpi-ngrme bange kx mrlzx? Murde trpnzngr kxmrlz, a' ngi txpwz Gct esz'-krde.
Krlzq natq kcng tqkapx Gct. Krlcde seleng: ‘Bzkq kx narmwimi doa kxtrngiu krnalzde. Bzkq kx narnibq. Bzkq kx napna da. Bzkq kx narpokiati leplz. Amrlue zvz trtem x lxem,’ x kzdung mou.”
A' rpibz ncblo kc kx, “Abzo pnz mzli kc tqngini-ngrne obla, vz-nqblq-angidrx natq lcng amrlx.”

Kx xlrbz Jiszs da lc, sc tqrpipebzle bade kx, “Mrbrpxbep da esz' kx naleq. Amwa mclrm amrlx x kabz trau rde mz leplz kx trpnzngr scdr da. Nzmu na-aleq da lc, nzrngiba-krm namyalz mou mrkc Heven. Vzm x vz-nqblq ninge.”
A' kx xlrbz ncblo lc le drtwrde vztx, murde nide ncblo kxrngisc x trsutiu drtwrde nzrlrtx-ngrbz da kcng.
Mctrpebz Jiszs drtwrde nzvz-krde sc tqrpipebzle kx, “Rblxtx-atwrnr-ngrbz mz leplz kx nzrngiscng nzmnclz-krbzlr mz Gct! Murde trnzkrlzlru kx nzmnc-xglelr nide mz da amrlx.
Kamel trkrlzleu nzdwatr-krde mrkc tqmrplxngr nidil. A' nzrblxkr kxnzrngiscng nzmnclz-krbzlr mz Gct myaszpxle da lc.”
Zbz sc tzrpipebzlr kx, “E kx tqmule lcde, trpengr kx narlapx!”
A' rpibz Jiszs kx, “Nike rblxbz mz ncblo tr-rblxpwzu mz Gct.”
Zbz rpibz Pita kx, “Obq ena! Rlaszpekr mr nyzgr mz nzvz-nqblq-krgr nim.”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Napi-angidrbo bamu. Ncblo kx rlaszle ma nyzde, o olvz rde, o mzledeng, o trtede x lxede, o doa nedeng mz nzvectr-krmle leplz mz Gct mz nzngini-krde King rdr,
Gct sa nakabzle bade da kxkqlu namyaszlzle mzli ka mz nrlc ka, da kx natekqtrle da kcng tqamrbrle. X mz nrlc kc navzm, sa natwz-kzle nzlungr kxboi.”
Nzwrde Kratq Kx Ycmnetrngr Jiszs Nzbz-krde

Zbz Jiszs vzmileng krkcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) mz kzdq nrlc mz nidr esz'-krdr, sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “Lalztqmamu! Navzpeku Jerusalem x mzli kc nakrlzlz-ngrbzku mrkc, da kcng amrlx tzyro profet kcng mzli kc, tzpi-ngrdr ninge mz nzngini-krnge Mrlx Leplz, sc tzngidatipeng.
Murde sa nakaobzlr ninge mz mqdr kxtrngiulrJiu. Sa naxtrnga-ngrdr ninge. Na-akrlo-ngrdr ninge. X nabyatilr ninge.
Naviplatilr ninge x nanibqlr ninge. A' mz zbq kratq sc tqlupe-moux.”
Da lcng trpnzngr kx yrplatitr nar ncblo nedeng. Drtwr ngr natq kcng yc-kapqbz badr. Trnzkrlzlru da lc tqycmnetrngr Jiszs.
Jiszs Amrlzle Kzdq Ncblo Kx Mzte Mwi
Jiszs badr zbo ngr leplz kcng, sc tzesonetrpebzng Jeriko. A' kzdq kc ncblo kx mzte mwi wxbune mz nrlar lrpzki, tqrlxne scde trau.
Kx xlrle zbo ngr leplz kcng tqvzng mrkc tqmnc-ngrde, sc tqveape, “?Nilc krlc tqkxmule lc?”
Nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Jiszs kc Naszret la tqvz mz lrpzki.”
Zbz sc tqnepxpe tqrpipele kx, “Jiszs, Mrlx Devet! Nayc mz drtwrm ninge!”
Leplz kcng tzrtwayzbzng nzlclvzlr nide x nzrpibzlr namnc-lrpi. A' sc tqaetunelz-zlwzle nate, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Mrlx Devet! Nayc mz drtwrm ninge!”
Kx xlrbz Jiszs natqde, sc tqtupe, x tqrkapebz natq kx ncblo kc mzte tqmwi navzmim bade. X mzli kc tqesotrpe-ngrbzle, Jiszs sc tqveapebz bade,
rpibzle kx, “?Nike suti drtwrm kx na-alebo bam?” Rpibzle kx, “Kxetu, naobq-moux.”
Zbz rpibz Jiszs bade kx, “Obq! Nzlxngiti-krm ninge amrlzpele nim.”
X mzli lcpwz mzte obqtxpx pnz, x sc tqvz-nqblqpele Jiszs, tqawibz mz Gct. Kx nzmcpe zbo ngr leplz kc le, sc tzglqlzpelr Gct.

footnotes.text: Leplz mz mzli nyz Jiszs, mz drtwrdr nzrpilr kx nzrngisckr ncblo da vzpxm mz nzamrlzkr Gct nide. Nzmu leplz kxnzrngiscng kx trnaprtrlru Heven e trpengr kx naprtr elr.

Trnzaopxpwzu mz lr Jiu kx Nzryrngrkxtr rpile kx Kxnzmcpx na-aetqbz drtqde x naobqszo nide, na-atrkati nide, x nanibq nide. [Sam 22:1-18; 69:8, 11, 20-21; 118:22a; Asaea 53:1-12] Murde nzlxngitilr natq Gct kc tqrpile kx Kxnzmcpx nangi king kc etu na-aovxiole enqmi rdrng amrlx x na-aclve-alole leplz amrlx, da kc nawaile mz nzyzlu-mou-krmle. A' trnzlxngitilru natq kzble lcng.
18:42 Natq lc tqngi amrlzpele mz Natqgu, nzyr pnz arlapxpele mz natq lr Grik. X natq lc drtwr ngrde amrlz mz nzyagoxngr x arlapx.
